title: Feedback ring: structured-metadata miner + typed spec verification outcomes
command: cargo test -p session-api transcript_feedback && cargo test -p spec-api verification
detail: Guards the robust-model rework: (1) transcript miner detects failed tool calls from structured metadata only (no text heuristics), (2) spec verified-state recompute returns typed SpecVerificationOutcome (NoGuards/Pending/Failed/Verified) instead of collapsed Ok(false).
